summary.en: Israel is conducting air and drone strikes in southern Lebanon that have killed a Hezbollah operative, wounded another, and killed a civilian on a motorcycle while wounding a second. Hezbollah is responding with artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. The conflict continues as both sides exchange fire, extending the displacement and humanitarian impact.
summary.nb: Israel gjennomfører luft- og droneangrep i sørlige Libanon som har drept en Hezbollah-operativ, såret en annen, og drept en sivil på motorsykkel mens en annen ble såret. Hezbollah svarer med artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og har begynt å distribuere sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevne i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Konflikten fortsetter mens begge sider utveksler ild, noe som forlenger fordrivelsen og den humanitære påvirkningen.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
